title: xuangoudelight
description: A Minecraft mod centered around the Chinese streamer Xuan Dog, featuring various structures, creatures, and bosses.
body:
This mod is centered around the Chinese internet League of Legends streamer Xuan Dog (Xuan Shen / Last.xuan) as its core content.

New Equipment
Shoe sole series, along with various weapons and armor.

New Creatures
Xuan Dog, Azi, and other creatures derived from Chinese internet memes, as well as several bosses such as Manager Chen and the Dragon of No.16 Middle School.

New Structures
Xuanmu Eyeglasses Store, Xuan's Mom Flavor Restaurant, No.16 Middle School, and more.

New Food
Xuanmai (chewing gum), Tangyuan (glutinous rice balls), and various food items derived from Farmer's Delight.

New Mechanics
Xuan's Will: You can accumulate Xuan's Will by consuming Xuanmai and other foods, allowing yourself to enter the immensely powerful Xuan Step state.
